entry.name: mc.transpose~
entry.description: The mc.transpose~ object groups one or more multichannel signal inputs into multichannel signal outputs where channels in the outputs share the same channel index in the inputs.

arguments.name: inlets
arguments.description: The first argument specifies the number of inlets. If no argument is given, the default is 2 inlets.

arguments.name: outlets
arguments.description: The second argument specifies the number of outlets. If the second argument is not present, 2 outlets will be created.

messages.name: signal
messages.description: Connect a multichannel signal to any inlet. The index of each channel in the input signals determines its output multichannel signal.

inlets.description: Theobject has a number of inlets specified by its first argument. Connect a multichannel signal to each inlet that you want to tranpose.

outlets.description: Theobject has a number of outlets specified by its second argument. Each outlet produces a multichannel signal consisting of all channels from signals connected to the object's inlets that share the same channel index. The left outlet will consist of all of the first channels from the input multichannel signals; the next outlet will consist of all of the second channels from the inlet multichannel signals, and so on.
